private-openai.notes: A $122B round (committed capital) closed March 31, 2026 at an $852B post-money valuation, anchored by Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank — now #2 behind Anthropic. OpenAI confidentially filed an S-1 around May 2026 (targeting roughly September 2026) but remains private.

private-bytedance.notes: Proposed secondary share sale led by General Atlantic at a $550B valuation (Feb 2026), targeting a 2026 close; supersedes the $500B SCMP mark but not yet a closed round.

private-anthropic.notes: Series H ($65B raise) closed May 28, 2026 at a $965B post-money valuation, led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia — now the most valuable AI startup ahead of OpenAI. Anthropic filed a confidential draft S-1 on June 1, 2026 but remains private.
